# Applied and customer scenarios

English · [Русский](../ru/themes/applied-scenarios.md) · ← [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md)

Open-ended situations with customers and messy problems: the first 48 hours, rescuing a pilot, decomposing a business problem.

## Both tracks

- **A customer wants to automate claims processing with AI. What would you do in the first two weeks?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you turn a broad request into a bounded, measurable workflow.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Map the current process, decisions, exceptions and accountable users.
    - Check data access, error consequences and which steps need human judgement.
    - Choose a narrow pilot with a baseline, acceptance criteria and an owner.
  - Read: [Building Effective AI Agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents) (Anthropic) · [AI Risk Management Framework](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework) (NIST)
- **A customer executive wants to cancel an AI pilot because it keeps producing wrong results. What would you do over the next 48 hours?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · Asked at: [Palantir](../companies/palantir.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you combine incident triage with a credible customer recovery plan.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Acknowledge impact and collect concrete failing workflows with the customer.
    - Contain harmful behaviour and separate data, system and expectation problems.
    - Agree on a short recovery experiment and explicit continue-or-stop criteria.
  - Read: [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google) · [Demystifying evals for AI agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/demystifying-evals-for-ai-agents) (Anthropic)
- **A customer insists on fine-tuning their own model on support tickets, while you suspect retrieval would be enough. How do you proceed?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · Asked at: [Databricks](../companies/databricks.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you investigate the need without turning architecture preferences into a sales argument.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Ask what ownership is meant to achieve: behaviour, knowledge, cost or control.
    - Build a representative task set and compare plausible approaches.
    - Explain data governance, maintenance and migration costs before recommending.
  - Read: [Rules of Machine Learning](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/guides/rules-of-ml) (Google for Developers) · [Building Effective AI Agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents) (Anthropic)
- **A deployed agent's base model will be retired in 60 days. How would you migrate it without losing quality?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · Asked at: [Databricks](../companies/databricks.md) †
  - Tests: Whether provider lifecycle risk is handled through reproducible evaluation and controlled change.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Inventory affected workflows, tool contracts and model-specific behaviour.
    - Compare candidates against representative recorded tasks and failure cases.
    - Plan staged migration, rollback within the available window and customer communication.
  - Read: [Demystifying evals for AI agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/demystifying-evals-for-ai-agents) (Anthropic) · [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google)
- **A customer says their eight-GPU chatbot is too slow and too expensive. You have a week with them; how do you use it?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you diagnose bottlenecks and evaluate changes against useful customer outcomes.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Measure real workload, latency distribution, utilisation and cost per successful task.
    - Profile before choosing serving, model, retrieval or interaction changes.
    - Validate improvements on the same workload with quality and reliability guardrails.
  - Read: [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google) · [Rules of Machine Learning](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/guides/rules-of-ml) (Google for Developers)
- **An enterprise wants document Q&A over two million internal files within four weeks, with no data leaving its VPC. How would you scope the pilot?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you negotiate scope around access controls, deployment constraints and measurable value.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Clarify corpus priority, permissions, permitted services and the most valuable queries.
    - Choose a representative subset and a deployable end-to-end workflow.
    - Agree acceptance tests, operational ownership and what the pilot cannot establish.
  - Read: [Architect multitenant solutions on Azure](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/guide/multitenant/overview) (Microsoft Learn) · [AI Risk Management Framework](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework) (NIST)
- **An enterprise customer says Claude hallucinates in their retrieval-based knowledge assistant. How would you investigate the first failures?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you separate retrieval failures, unsupported generation and misunderstood user expectations.
- **A freight railway loses substantial revenue to unexpected locomotive downtime. Turn the problem into an engineering plan.**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · Asked at: [Palantir](../companies/palantir.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you connect operational decisions, usable data and intervention value.
- **How would you design a system to improve traffic in New York City?**
  - System design · Senior · Asked at: [Palantir](../companies/palantir.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you decompose an ambiguous city-scale objective into measurable interventions.
- **Design synchronisation between two systems that hold employee records.**
  - System design · Senior · Asked at: [Palantir](../companies/palantir.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you identify record ownership, conflicts and recovery semantics.
- **Design an application for recording species while exploring an unfamiliar environment.**
  - System design · Senior · Asked at: [Palantir](../companies/palantir.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you clarify field constraints and support trustworthy data collection.
- **A customer wants to replace a proprietary frontier-model API with an open model. How would you run the engagement?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior
  - Tests: Whether the migration plan tests quality, operating costs and ownership assumptions.
- **A robotics customer requests 50,000 hours of demonstrations across twelve tasks and three robot types. How would you organise collection and decide what data to keep?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior
  - Tests: Whether collection targets are tied to coverage and usable demonstrations rather than hours alone.
- **Estimate the cost and turnaround of AI due diligence over 5,000 documents. Which improvement would you investigate first?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior
  - Tests: Whether estimates expose workload assumptions and the dominant cost driver.
- **A lawyer reports that the assistant missed a change-of-control clause during contract review. How would you investigate?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you trace the failure through ingestion, retrieval, reasoning and review.

## AI Leadership

- **How would you explain a complex AI research result to a nontechnical audience?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you communicate implications and limitations without replacing evidence with hype.
- **A prospective customer already runs on H100 GPUs. When would you recommend that they keep their current setup?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you can reject a migration when customer economics do not justify it.
- **A hospital group schedules outpatient visits manually by phone. What would you build for them?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you design around workflow, integration and safe exception handling.
- **A contact centre wants voice agents to replace its phone menus. How would you lead the engagement?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you scope user journeys, handoff and operational readiness together.
- **A public agency wants a multilingual assistant for a paper-and-call-centre welfare service, hosted on premises. How would you scope delivery?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior
  - Tests: Whether access, language coverage and deployment constraints shape the service.
